title: Your lab partner shares a “new analysis tool”
scenario: A lab partner sends a link to a new AI analysis tool and says the professor wants everyone to connect their university drive before tomorrow’s meeting. The app asks for full file and email access.

answers.A: Use a test file or separate non-sensitive account if the tool can be evaluated without real research data.
answers.B: Approve access because your lab partner is trusted and the meeting is tomorrow.
answers.C: Verify with the professor/lab lead and request the approved tool link through a known university channel before granting access.

explanation: Compromised collaborators and overbroad OAuth permissions can expose research, email and personal files.
proTip: A new tool should prove its need before you grant old data.
